statement: For alpha+beta+gamma=9 general point, line-tangency and plane-tangency conditions on nonsingular quadrics in P3, the solution count is the coefficient of T0^(9-alpha)T1^(20-beta)T2^(9-gamma) in the multidegree of the complete-quadric prime ideal I4 specified in Theorem 3.1. This recovers all 55 entries of Figure1; in particular the (3,3,3) count is 104 and the (2,5,2) count is 128.
